thread:
alex: FYI customer Acme Corp hit us — they applied a promo while on the free trial and got immediately charged. They expected the promo to stack with trial credits but the trial was removed and invoice created. Ticket CS-4821. :grimacing:

alex: Short repro from their side:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/apply \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"user_id":"acct_123","promo_code":"ACME50"}'
```

alex: API returned 200 and showed applied promo, but the user's trial_entitlement was replaced. They attached these DB snippets:
```
-- BEFORE: promo_entitlements
-- user_id | promo_code | credits
-- acct_123 | TRIAL1000 | 1000

-- AFTER:
-- acct_123 | ACME50 | 500
```

priya: @jordan can you triage? need invoice id + stripe charge for refund. Also want to know whether applyPromo is supposed to replace or stack by design. :eyes:

jordan: tagging @sam-eng-oncall and @emi-billing. my quick read: we shipped a change in promo-service last week (PR #1564) that introduced replace semantics when incoming promo has lifetime scope "exclusive". Could be a misclassification on ACME50.

jordan: Can you paste the invoice id from the customer? we need the charge id to issue refund and avoid next billing run.

alex: Invoice id is inv_1JZ4X2ABC, charge ch_1JZ4X2DEF. Customer provided a screenshot of immediate $25 charge.

billing-bot: Automated alert: detected new charge ch_1JZ4X2DEF flagged for potential promo overwrite pattern. Suggested action: create refund intent and hold any automated dunning.

sam: I'll take on the infra side. Repro steps I'll run locally: create test user, insert TRIAL1000 into promo_entitlements, call /v1/promos/apply with ACME50, inspect delta. If replace=true default triggers, need to check boolean flag in promo-service:applyHandler.

emi: From billing side: if confirmed overwrite, we should refund full charge and recredit the trial + apply ACME50 on top (stack). We should also check historical data migration that toggled exclusive flag for a subset of promos. I'll prepare refund template and run once Jordan confirms root cause.

jordan: Quick log excerpt from promo-service around the time:
```
promo-service.INFO: handling applyPromo user=acct_123 promo=ACME50 ctx="applyHandler"
promo-service.DEBUG: promo-meta {"scope": "exclusive", "stackable": false} 
consumer WARN: replacing existing entitlements for acct_123 (was TRIAL1000)
```

jordan: That debug struct looks wrong — ACME50 should have stackable: true. Suspect a metadata sync job that overwrote promo metadata. See migration job promos/migrate_scope_v2.

priya: OK plan: 1) Refund charge ch_1JZ4X2DEF (emi) 2) Reapply trial credit 1000 + ACME50 stack for the customer (sam/emi) 3) Block promo metadata migration job until we confirm (jordan) 4) Postmortem if >1 affected account.

priya: Can someone run a query to find other users impacted by promos with scope=exclusive but promo_id in set (ACME50, NEWYEAR2025)? e.g.
```
SELECT user_id FROM promo_entitlements pe
JOIN promos p ON pe.promo_code = p.code
WHERE p.scope = 'exclusive' AND p.code IN ('ACME50','NEWYEAR2025');
```

sam: Running that now on replica, will share counts. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: Quick counts: 3 users affected for ACME50, 0 for NEWYEAR2025 on replica. I'll queue up a safe refund + reapply script for the three if confirmed.

alex: Customer is asking for ETA on refund — said this is blocking their internal procurement. Could we do immediate manual refund and recredit now?

emi: I can issue manual refund right away once I have authorization from priya. After refund I'll drop the TRIAL1000 back into their account and call apply endpoint with forced stack flag.

priya: authorize refund ch_1JZ4X2DEF, emi pls proceed. Jordan, block the migration job and open revert PR if necessary. Sam, run script to reapply entitlements for the 3 impacted users after emi confirms refunds.

jordan: Blocking migration job promos/migrate_scope_v2 now. Opening issue GH-2478. Will also add a hotfix to ensure promo metadata has stackable flag validated on apply.

alex: Customer confirmed they saw refund notification. Thanks team. :relieved:

priya: Follow-ups: add an e2e test for stacking semantics, add a metric for "promo-apply replaced entitlements" and alert when >0 in an hour. I'll own the follow-up.

alex: Thanks all. Will update CS ticket CS-4821 with timeline and steps.

sam: I'll post PR number for the reapply script once done.

emi: Refund done for ch_1JZ4X2DEF, recredit + reapply ACME50 completed for acct_123. Customer confirmed zero balance and applied promo.

alex: Perfect, closing loop with customer. :thumbsup:
